unlisted_practices: Report per-case time, resource, and energy use alongside clinical outcomes to make sustainability of AI copilot robots auditable.

Establish rigorous reliability assurance frameworks, including uncertainty-calibrated reasoning and surgeon-in-the-loop supervision, so that reasoning-driven surgical robots remain safe under constrained computational budgets.
Develop adaptive explainability that selectively discloses detailed reasoning traces in low-confidence situations or on surgeon request.
Establish standardized cross-institutional benchmarks for evaluating reasoning fidelity and safety-critical failure modes of surgical AI copilot robots.
Develop interoperability frameworks and APIs to integrate reasoning-driven models with surgical robot control systems such as kinematic interfaces and haptic feedback modules.
Develop real-time deformable preoperative-to-intraoperative alignment, uncertainty-aware multimodal fusion, and benchmarks linking fusion quality to safety-critical outcomes.
